Container.Name: Butterfly
Container.Overview: Butterfly is a self-hosted, Monarch-style personal finance dashboard that reads from your Actual Budget server (fed by SimpleFIN bank sync): cash flow Sankey, spending, transactions, net worth, accounts, loans and a page per property. Runs with demo data until you fill in the Actual settings.
Container.Requires: A running Actual Budget server (for example the actualbudget/actual-server container), with SimpleFIN set up inside Actual for bank sync.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Butterfly web interface

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Butterfly settings (property pages, account types) and the local copy of your Actual budget

Config.Name: Actual Server URL
Config.Description: URL of your Actual Budget server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5006. Leave empty for demo data.

Config.Name: Actual Password
Config.Description: The password you use to log in to Actual

Config.Name: Actual Sync ID
Config.Description: In Actual: Settings, Show advanced settings, Sync ID

Config.Name: Actual Encryption Password
Config.Description: Only if your budget file uses end-to-end encryption

Config.Name: Butterfly Password
Config.Description: Optional: require this password to open Butterfly

Config.Name: Claude API Key
Config.Description: Optional: Claude API key (console.anthropic.com) for Categorize with AI on the Transactions page

Config.Name: AI Model
Config.Description: Claude model used for Categorize with AI

Config.Name: Cache Seconds
Config.Description: How long to reuse data from Actual between page loads
